responsibility: Name the module and export a converted .jess file imports for each Less or Sass built-in function call, so every .less/.scss → .jess conversion spells built-in calls the same way.

decision.need: .jess has no ambient function namespace (ledger P17), so converting a .less or .scss file must import each built-in it calls from the dialect's trusted module. Four conversion suites each derived that projection themselves; one Sass copy was a hand-written one-entry subset.

considered.finding: emitJess takes the projection as its `functions` option on purpose: which module and which names are the converter's facts (the source dialect's registry), not the printer's. Core cannot import @jesscss/fns.
They derive each dialect's dispatch table from its index and so own the call name → export pairs, but not the `#less`/`#sass` specifier a .jess file imports from.
Each plugin already owns its trusted specifier through ProvidedModules; that is the module a converted file must name.
Two Less copies were identical, one Sass copy filtered on `typeof fn === 'function'` instead of the registry predicate, and one Sass copy listed a single function.

decision.rationale: Extend each dialect plugin with one jessFunctions() beside the specifier it already owns, built from the registry's own derivation (exportNamesByCall), and have every conversion call it. A later change to a dialect's built-ins or its module then reaches every conversion.

replace.to:
import lessPlugin from '@jesscss/plugin-less';
import { lessExportNames } from '@jesscss/fns/less/registry';

import lessPlugin, { jessFunctions } from '@jesscss/plugin-less';
import { lessExportNames } from '@jesscss/fns/less/registry';

void jessFunctions();
const LESS_FUNCTIONS = { from: '#less', names: lessExportNames() };

import { jessFunctions } from '@jesscss/plugin-less';
import { lessExportNames } from '@jesscss/fns/less/registry';

void jessFunctions();
const LESS_FUNCTIONS = { from: '#less', names: lessExportNames() };

import { jessFunctions } from '@jesscss/plugin-scss';
import { sassExportNames } from '@jesscss/fns/sass/registry';

void jessFunctions();
const SASS_FUNCTIONS = { from: '#sass', names: sassExportNames() };

import { jessFunctions } from '@jesscss/plugin-scss';
import { sassExportNames } from '@jesscss/fns/sass/registry';

void jessFunctions();
const functions = { from: '#sass', names: sassExportNames() };

owns: the module specifier a converted file imports a dialect's built-ins from
the call name → export name pairs, derived from the dialect index
consumerOwns: the import path rewrite of converted @import targets
its assertions over the converted output
allowed: Pass jessFunctions() (or a value spread from it) as emitJess's `functions` option.
rules.extend: A new dialect's conversion adds a jessFunctions() beside that plugin's ProvidedModules specifier, built with exportNamesByCall over the dialect index, and its consumers join this contract.
forbidden: Build a `{ from: '#less' | '#sass', names }` projection outside the owner.
Import the owner while converting with a local map.
